# Rohit Malekar

> Essays, notes, and selected work on coordination, public goods, product craft, and living well.

Rohit Malekar writes and thinks in public at rohitmalekar.in. This site is a digital garden — essays compound from atomic notes over time.

## Writings

Essays organized into four themes:

- [Coordination & Public Goods](https://rohitmalekar.in/articles/coordination/): Essays on funding systems, collective action, and digital public goods.
- [The Art of Work](https://rohitmalekar.in/articles/art-of-work/): Reflections on careers, product craft, and doing meaningful work.
- [Building Better Orgs](https://rohitmalekar.in/articles/building-better-orgs/): Writing on organizations, leadership, and coordination inside institutions.
- [Living Well](https://rohitmalekar.in/articles/living-well/): Essays on habits, health, and the examined life.

## Notes

- [Notes](https://rohitmalekar.in/notes/): Atomic notes library — short reflections and referenced ideas that compound into essays over time.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://rohitmalekar.in/portfolio/): Selected work across research, data tools, writing, and speaking — funding systems and analytics for digital public goods.
